articles.title: Trump Tries Again to Change Who Gets to Be a U.S. Citizen at Birth
articles.summary: President Trump signed new rules that could stop some babies born in the U.S. from becoming citizens. The rules target kids of diplomats, UN workers, and people who travel here just to give birth. Experts say it might not be legal.

articles.title: Girls Take the Field! First-Ever Women's Pro Baseball League Opens in Illinois
articles.summary: The Women's Pro Baseball League played its first game ever in Springfield, Illinois. Hundreds of fans from around the world came to cheer for teams like the Los Angeles Queens and New York Heights. The league has four teams and will play for six weeks.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan Sign a 'Shield of Peace' Defense Pact
articles.summary: Three big countries — Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan — signed a deal in Mecca promising to protect each other if one is attacked. They say it's for peace, but experts think it's also a warning to Iran.
